Details: All rows are synthetic adult resting-baseline controls generated for this workbook. They are not real EHR observations and do not represent a sampled or validated healthy cohort.
Each CSV contains 1,750 synthetic rows. The heart-attack file has 350 synthetic patients with 5 sequential readings each; the other files have 1,750 single-record controls each.

Palpitations control ages are adjusted so their mean is 54.30 years, matching the corresponding disease dataset. Stroke control ages average 53.53 years to two decimals, matching the corresponding disease dataset. The heart-attack and general schemas have no age_years column, so no source age average is available to match.

Synthetic values are sampled within these illustrative adult resting bands: HR 60-100 bpm; SpO2 95-100%; BP 90/60 to below 120/80 mmHg; temperature 36.5-37.3 °C; respiratory rate 12-18 breaths/min. The generated bands are narrowed in some columns to stay inside the reference bands.
Reference: MedlinePlus vital signs: https://www.medlineplus.gov/ency/article/002341.htm ; SpO2: https://medlineplus.gov/lab-tests/pulse-oximetry/ ; AHA BP: https://www.heart.org/en/health-topics/high-blood-pressure/blood-pressure-explained/

Details: Risk and warning-symptom flags are set to 0 by construction. Stroke-file glucose, BMI, HDL, and LDL are illustrative synthetic values, not validated health labels. Demographics are synthetic adult values.

diagnosis_label and condition_label identify synthetic controls. event_label is 0. tier_level is 0 by construction per user instruction. These labels are not source-observed clinical outcomes or clinician-assigned priority.

Do not merge these rows as real patient data or use them alone to train or validate clinical triage. The generated records have simple artificial distributions and may cause data leakage or overly optimistic model results.

For the synthetic heart-attack file, heart rate and SpO2 vary slightly across five sequential records per synthetic patient. The interval is set to five minutes for this generated series; this timing is synthetic.
